name: GamingAgent (lmgame-Bench)
description: LLM and vision-language gaming agents plus a benchmark harness that plays classic video games and scores model performance.
whatItDoes: Runs models as players in games such as platformers and puzzles, with or without an agent harness, and records results and replay videos. It is aimed at researchers evaluating models.
howItWorks: A Python runner launches game environments, feeds observations to a chosen model with optional perception, memory and reasoning modules, and applies the returned actions. Some games need ROM files imported by the user.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: One provider key is needed; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY are also read
